sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select rule,code,owner,due_on,finding from quality_findings order by due_on,code

sections.title: Performance and review dates
sections.sql: select code,name,risk,review_due,inspections,failed,open_capas,overdue_capas from quality_supplier_scorecard order by overdue_capas desc,code

sections.title: Document reviews
sections.sql: select code,title,revision,owner,review_due from documents where status='effective' order by review_due
